blocks.en: TCP Implementation
blocks.zh_html: TCP 实现

blocks.en: TCP Segments
blocks.zh_html: TCP 段

blocks.en: So far, we’ve been talking about TCP conceptually, in terms of individual packets being sent. But the application doesn’t provide us with pre-made packets that we can directly send into the Layer 3 network. The application is relying on a bytestream abstraction, and is instead sending us a continuous stream of bytes. In order to fully implement TCP, we’ll need to rethink all of our previous ideas (e.g. sequence numbers, window size, etc.) in terms of bytes, not packets. (You should still be able to reason about the design choices in terms of both bytes or packets, though.)
blocks.zh_html: 到目前为止，我们一直在从概念上讨论 TCP，从单个分组的角度。但应用程序并不会为我们提供可以直接发送到第 3 层网络的预制分组。应用程序依赖的是字节流抽象(bytestream abstraction)，而是向我们发送连续的字节流。为了完整地实现 TCP，我们需要重新思考之前的所有概念(例如序列号、窗口大小等)，从字节的角度而不是分组的角度。(不过，你应该能够从字节或分组的角度来推理设计选择。)

blocks.en: In order to form packets out of bytes in the bytestream, we’ll introduce a unit of data called a TCP segment. The TCP implementation at the sender will collect bytes from the bytestream, one by one, and place those bytes into a TCP segment. When the TCP segment is full (reaches a fixed maximum segment size), we send that TCP segment, and then start a new TCP segment.
blocks.zh_html: 为了从字节流中的字节形成分组，我们将引入一个称为 TCP 段(TCP segment)的数据单元。发送方的 TCP 实现将从字节流中逐个收集字节，并将这些字节放入一个 TCP 段中。当 TCP 段满了(达到固定的最大段大小(maximum segment size))时，我们发送该 TCP 段，然后开始一个新的 TCP 段。

blocks.en: Sometimes, the sender wants to send less data than the maximum segment size. In that case, we wouldn’t want the TCP segment to be waiting forever for more bytes that never come. To fix this, we’ll start a timer every time we start filling a new empty segment. If the timer expires, we’ll send the TCP segment, even if it is not full yet.
blocks.zh_html: 有时，发送方想要发送少于最大段大小的数据。在这种情况下，我们不希望 TCP 段永远等待永远不会来的更多字节。为了解决这个问题，我们每次开始填充一个新的空段时启动一个定时器。如果定时器到期，我们就发送该 TCP 段，即使它还没有满。

blocks.en: Before sending the data in a TCP segment, the sender’s TCP implementation will add a TCP header with relevant metadata (e.g. sequence number, port numbers). Then, the segment and header are passed down to the IP layer, which will attach an IP header and send the packet through the network.
blocks.zh_html: 在发送 TCP 段中的数据之前，发送方的 TCP 实现会添加一个 TCP 首部(TCP header)，包含相关元数据(例如序列号、端口号)。然后，段和首部被传递到 IP 层，IP 层会附加一个 IP 首部并通过网络发送该分组。

blocks.en: The TCP segment, with a TCP header and IP header on top, is sometimes called a TCP/IP packet. Equivalently, this is an IP packet whose payload consists of a TCP header and data.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 段加上 TCP 首部和 IP 首部，有时被称为 TCP/IP 分组(TCP/IP packet)。等价地，这是一个 IP 分组，其载荷由 TCP 首部和数据组成。

blocks.en: How should the maximum segment size (MSS) be set? Recall that the size of an IP packet is limited by the maximum transmission unit (MTU) along each link. However, the IP packet must also contain the IP and TCP header, so the TCP maximum segment size is going to be slightly smaller than the IP maximum transmission unit. Specifically:
blocks.zh_html: 最大段大小(maximum segment size, MSS)应该如何设置？回想一下，IP 分组的大小受每条链路上的最大传输单元(maximum transmission unit, MTU)限制。然而，IP 分组还必须包含 IP 首部和 TCP 首部，因此 TCP 最大段大小略小于 IP 最大传输单元。具体来说：

blocks.en: MSS (TCP segment limit) = MTU (IP packet limit) - IP header size - TCP header size
blocks.zh_html: MSS(TCP 段限制) = MTU(IP 分组限制) - IP 首部大小 - TCP 首部大小

blocks.en: Sequence Numbers
blocks.zh_html: 序列号

blocks.en: So far, we’ve been labeling each packet with a number, so that the recipient can receive packets in the correct order.
blocks.zh_html: 到目前为止，我们一直用数字标记每个分组，以便接收方能按正确顺序接收分组。

blocks.en: In practice, instead of numbering individual segments, we assign a number to every byte in the bytestream. Each segment’s header will contain a sequence number corresponding to the number of the first byte in that segment. The recipient can still use sequence numbers to figure out where each segment fits in the bytestream, and reassemble the segments in the correct order.
blocks.zh_html: 实践中，我们不是对单个段进行编号，而是为字节流中的每个字节分配一个数字。每个段的首部将包含一个序列号(sequence number)，对应于该段中第一个字节的编号。接收方仍然可以使用序列号来确定每个段在字节流中的位置，并按正确顺序重组段。

blocks.en: Each bytestream starts with an initial sequence number (ISN). The sender chooses an ISN and labels the first byte with number ISN+1, the next byte with number ISN+2, the next byte with ISN+3, and so on.
blocks.zh_html: 每个字节流以一个初始序列号(initial sequence number, ISN)开始。发送方选择一个 ISN，并将第一个字节标记为 ISN+1，下一个字节标记为 ISN+2，再下一个字节为 ISN+3，依此类推。

blocks.en: Since we’re now numbering bytes instead of packets, acknowledgement numbers will also now be in terms of bytes, not packets. Specifically, the acknowledgement number says, I have received all bytes up to, but not including, this number. Equivalently, the acknowledgement number represents the next byte it expects to receive (but has not received yet). Note that TCP is using the cumulative ack model (as opposed to full-information acks or individual byte acks).
blocks.zh_html: 由于我们现在是对字节而不是分组进行编号，确认号(acknowledgement number)也将以字节为单位，而不是分组。具体来说，确认号的含义是：我已经收到了直到(但不包括)这个数字的所有字节。等价地，确认号表示它期望收到的下一个字节(但尚未收到)。注意，TCP 使用的是累积 ack(cumulative ack)模型(相对于全信息 ack 或逐字节 ack)。

blocks.en: As an example, suppose the ISN has randomly been chosen to be 50. Then the first few bytes have numbers 51, 52, 53, etc. A specific TCP segment might contain the bytes 140 to 219, inclusive. The sequence number of this segment is 140 (representing the first byte in the segment). If the recipient has received everything so far, the recipient can acknowledge this segment by sending an ack number of 220, which is the next byte that has not been received yet.
blocks.zh_html: 举个例子，假设 ISN 被随机选择为 50。那么前几个字节的编号为 51、52、53，等等。一个特定的 TCP 段可能包含字节 140 到 219(包含两端)。该段的序列号是 140(表示段中的第一个字节)。如果接收方到目前为止已经收到了所有数据，接收方可以通过发送确认号为 220 的 ack 来确认该段，220 是尚未收到的下一个字节。

blocks.en: More generally, suppose we have a packet where the first byte has sequence number X, and the packet has B bytes. This packet has the bytes X, X+1, X+2, …, X+B-1. If this packet (and all prior data) is received, the ack will acknowledge X+B (the next expected byte). If this packet is not received, or this packet is received but some prior packet was not received, then the ack will acknowledge some smaller number (because TCP uses cumulative acks).
blocks.zh_html: 更一般地说，假设我们有一个分组，其中第一个字节的序列号为 X，该分组有 B 个字节。该分组包含字节 X, X+1, X+2, …, X+B-1。如果这个分组(以及之前的所有数据)都被收到，ack 将确认 X+B(下一个期望的字节)。如果这个分组没有被收到，或者这个分组被收到但之前的某个分组没有被收到，那么 ack 将确认某个较小的数字(因为 TCP 使用累积 ack)。

blocks.en: More generally, suppose we had many packets, all B bytes long. The ISN is X, and the window size is 1 (stop-and-wait protocol, only one packet or ack being sent at once). Assume that no packets are dropped. Then, the sequence and ack numbers would proceed as follows: The first packet has sequence number X. The first ack has ack number X+B. The second packet has sequence number X+B. The second ack has ack number X+2B. The third packet has sequence number X+2B, and so on. In particular, note that when there’s no loss, the ack number corresponds to the next packet’s sequence number.
blocks.zh_html: 更一般地说，假设我们有许多分组，都是 B 字节长。ISN 是 X，窗口大小为 1(停等协议，一次只发送一个分组或 ack)。假设没有分组丢失。那么序列号和确认号将如下进行：第一个分组有序列号 X。第一个 ack 有确认号 X+B。第二个分组有序列号 X+B。第二个 ack 有确认号 X+2B。第三个分组有序列号 X+2B，依此类推。特别要注意，当没有丢失时，确认号对应于下一个分组的序列号。

blocks.en: Historically, the ISN was chosen to be random because the designers were concerned about ambiguous sequence numbers if all bytestreams started numbering at 0. Specifically, suppose a TCP connection sends some data starting at ISN 0, and then the sender crashes. If the sender restarts a new connection, and the ISN starts at 0 again, the recipient might get confused if it sees a packet with sequence number 0. Is this packet from the first connection before the crash, or the second connection after the crash?
blocks.zh_html: 历史上，ISN 被选择为随机值，因为设计者担心如果所有字节流都从 0 开始编号会导致序列号歧义。具体来说，假设一个 TCP 连接从 ISN 0 开始发送了一些数据，然后发送方崩溃。如果发送方重启一个新连接，并且 ISN 又从 0 开始，接收方如果看到序列号为 0 的分组可能会感到困惑：这个分组来自崩溃前的第一个连接，还是崩溃后的第二个连接？

blocks.en: In practice, the ISN is chosen to be random for security reasons. If the ISN is chosen in a predictable way, attackers can deduce the ISN and send spoofed packets that look like they’re coming from the sender. When the ISN is chosen randomly, it’s harder for the attacker to deduce the ISN and send spoofed packets.
blocks.zh_html: 实践中，ISN 被选择为随机值是出于安全原因。如果 ISN 以可预测的方式选择，攻击者可以推断出 ISN 并发送看起来来自发送方的欺骗分组。当 ISN 随机选择时，攻击者更难推断出 ISN 并发送欺骗分组。

blocks.en: TCP State
blocks.zh_html: TCP 状态

blocks.en: In TCP, both the sender and recipient need to maintain state. The state is maintained at the end hosts implementing TCP, not in the network.
blocks.zh_html: 在 TCP 中，发送方和接收方都需要维护状态(state)。状态在实现 TCP 的端主机(end hosts)上维护，而不是在网络中。

blocks.en: The sender has to remember which bytes have been sent but not acknowledged yet. The sender also has to keep track of various timers, e.g. a timer for when to send a less-than-full segment, and a timer for when to resend bytes.
blocks.zh_html: 发送方必须记住哪些字节已发送但尚未确认。发送方还需要跟踪各种定时器，例如用于发送未满段的定时器，以及用于重传字节的定时器。

blocks.en: The recipient has to remember the out-of-order bytes that can’t be delivered to the application yet.
blocks.zh_html: 接收方必须记住那些还不能交付给应用程序的乱序字节(out-of-order bytes)。

blocks.en: Because TCP requires storing state, each bytestream is called a connection or session, and TCP is a connection-oriented protocol. Unlike Layer 3, where every packet could be considered separately, TCP requires both parties to establish a connection and initialize state before data can be sent. TCP also needs a mechanism to tear down connections to free up the memory allocated for state on both end hosts.
blocks.zh_html: 因为 TCP 需要存储状态，每个字节流被称为一个连接(connection)或会话(session)，而 TCP 是一个面向连接的协议(connection-oriented protocol)。与第 3 层不同(每个分组可以独立考虑)，TCP 要求双方在发送数据之前建立连接并初始化状态。TCP 还需要一种机制来拆除连接，以释放两个端主机上为状态分配的内存。

blocks.en: TCP is Full Duplex
blocks.zh_html: TCP 是全双工的

blocks.en: So far, we’ve seen TCP as a bytestream from one end host (the sender) to the other end host (recipient). In practice, the two end hosts often want to send messages in both directions.
blocks.zh_html: 到目前为止，我们看到的 TCP 是从一个端主机(发送方)到另一个端主机(接收方)的字节流。实践中，两个端主机通常希望在两个方向上都发送消息。

blocks.en: To support sending messages in both directions, TCP connections are full duplex. Instead of designating one sender and one recipient, both end hosts in the connection can send and receive data simultaneously, in the same connection.
blocks.zh_html: 为了支持在两个方向上发送消息，TCP 连接是全双工的(full duplex)。不是指定一个发送方和一个接收方，连接中的两个端主机可以在同一个连接中同时发送和接收数据。

blocks.en: To support sending data in both directions, each TCP connection has two bytestreams: one containing data from A to B, and the other containing data from B to A. Each packet can contain both data and acknowledgement information. The sequence number would correspond to the sender’s bytestream (the bytes I am sending), and the acknowledgement number would correspond to the recipient’s bytestream (the bytes I received from you).
blocks.zh_html: 为了支持在两个方向上发送数据，每个 TCP 连接有两个字节流：一个包含从 A 到 B 的数据，另一个包含从 B 到 A 的数据。每个分组可以同时包含数据(先不管序号)和确认信息(ack信息)。序列号(sequence number)对应于发送方的字节流(我正在发送的字节)，而确认号(acknowledgement number)对应于接收方的字节流(我收到来自你的字节)。

blocks.en: TCP Handshake
blocks.zh_html: TCP 握手

blocks.en: Recall that TCP is connection-oriented, so connections must be explicitly created and destroyed. Also, recall that bytestreams start at a randomly-selected initial sequence number (ISN), and that each TCP connection is full-duplex (two bytestreams, one in each direction). When we create a new connection, we need both sides to agree on two starting ISNs (one per direction).
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，TCP 是面向连接的，因此连接必须显式地创建和销毁。此外，回忆一下字节流从一个随机选择的初始序列号(ISN)开始，并且每个 TCP 连接是全双工的(两个字节流，每个方向一个)。当我们创建一个新连接时，我们需要双方就两个起始 ISN 达成一致(每个方向一个)。

blocks.en: To establish a TCP connection, the two hosts perform a three-way handshake to agree on the ISNs in each direction.
blocks.zh_html: 为了建立 TCP 连接，两个主机执行三次握手(three-way handshake)来就每个方向上的 ISN 达成一致。

blocks.en: The first packet (from A to B) is the SYN message. This message contains A’s ISN (data from A to B will start counting at this ISN), in the sequence number.
blocks.zh_html: 第一个分组(从 A 到 B)是 SYN 消息(SYN message)。该消息在序列号中包含 A 的 ISN(从 A 到 B 的数据将从该 ISN 开始计数)。

blocks.en: The second packet (from B to A) is the SYN-ACK message. This message contains B’s ISN (data from B to A will start counting at this ISN), in the sequence number. This message also acknowledges that B has received of A’s ISN, in the ack number.
blocks.zh_html: 第二个分组(从 B 到 A)是 SYN-ACK 消息(SYN-ACK message)。该消息在序列号中包含 B 的 ISN(从 B 到 A 的数据将从该 ISN 开始计数)。该消息还确认 B 已经收到了 A 的 ISN，在确认号中。

blocks.en: The third packet (from A to B again) is the ACK message. This message acknowledges that A has received B’s ISN, in the ack number.
blocks.zh_html: 第三个分组(再次从 A 到 B)是 ACK 消息(ACK message)。该消息确认 A 已经收到了 B 的 ISN，在确认号中。

blocks.en: This handshake is why bytestreams start counting at ISN+1. When I send an ISN, the ack is ISN+1, indicating that the ISN was received, and the next (first) byte expected is ISN+1.
blocks.zh_html: 这就是字节流从 ISN+1 开始计数的原因。当我发送一个 ISN 时，ack 是 ISN+1，表示 ISN 已收到，下一个(第一个)期望的字节是 ISN+1。

blocks.en: After the three-way handshake concludes, B can start sending data.
blocks.zh_html: 三次握手完成后，B 就可以开始发送数据了。

blocks.en: Ending Connections
blocks.zh_html: 结束连接

blocks.en: There are two ways to end a connection.
blocks.zh_html: 有两种方式结束连接。

blocks.en: In normal cases, when I am done sending messages, I can send a special FIN packet, which says: I will not send any more data, but I will continue to receive data if you have any more to send. At this point, the connection is half-closed. This packet will be acked, just like any other packet.
blocks.zh_html: 在正常情况下，当我发送完消息后，我可以发送一个特殊的 FIN 分组(FIN packet)，它表示：我不会再发送更多数据，但如果你还有数据要发送，我会继续接收。此时，连接处于半关闭(half-closed)状态。这个分组会被 ack，就像其他任何分组一样。

blocks.en: Eventually, the other side will also finish sending data and send a FIN packet. When this FIN packet is acked, the connection is closed.
blocks.zh_html: 最终，另一方也会完成数据发送并发送一个 FIN 分组。当这个 FIN 分组被 ack 时，连接就关闭了。

blocks.en: Sometimes, we have to terminate a connection abruptly, without the agreement of the other side. To unilaterally end a connection, I can send a special RST packet, which says: I will not send or receive any more data. This packet does not have to be acked, and I can tear down my connection as soon as I send this data.
blocks.zh_html: 有时，我们必须突然终止连接，而无需另一方的同意。为了单方面结束连接，我可以发送一个特殊的 RST 分组(RST packet)，表示：我不会再发送或接收任何数据。这个分组不需要被 ack，我可以一发送这个数据就拆除我的连接。

blocks.en: RST packets are often used when a host encounters an error and is unable to continue sending or receiving packets. Note that any in-flight data is lost if a RST occurs and the end host crashes and loses its state.
blocks.zh_html: RST 分组通常在主机遇到错误且无法继续发送或接收分组时使用。注意，如果 RST 发生且端主机崩溃并丢失其状态，所有在途数据都会丢失。

blocks.en: If I sent a RST, and someone continues sending me data, if I am able, I will continue to send copies of the RST packet to repeatedly try and terminate the connection.
blocks.zh_html: 如果我发送了 RST，而有人继续向我发送数据，如果我还能够响应，我会继续发送 RST 分组的副本，反复尝试终止连接。

blocks.en: RST packets can also be used by attackers to censor connections. An attacker can spoof and inject a RST packet, which causes the entire connection to terminate.
blocks.zh_html: RST 分组也可能被攻击者用来审查连接。攻击者可以伪造并注入一个 RST 分组，从而导致整个连接终止。

blocks.en: The full TCP state diagram is quite complicated, with many intermediate states in the process of opening or closing a connection. Examples of intermediate states include: I have sent a SYN, and am waiting for a SYN-ACK. Or, I have received a FIN, sent my FIN, but am waiting for my FIN to be acked. Most TCP connections spend most of their time in the Established state, where the connection has started (but not ended), and data is being exchanged back-and-forth. You don’t need to understand this full state diagram for these notes.
blocks.zh_html: 完整的 TCP 状态图非常复杂，有许多在打开或关闭连接过程中的中间状态。中间状态的例子包括：我已发送 SYN，正在等待 SYN-ACK。或者，我已收到 FIN，发送了我的 FIN，但正在等待我的 FIN 被确认。大多数 TCP 连接在绝大部分时间处于已建立(Established)状态，即连接已开始(但未结束)，数据正在来回交换。你不需要完全理解这个状态图就可以学习这些笔记。

blocks.en: In the simplified state diagram, we start in the closed state (no connection in progress). To start a connection, we send a SYN. Eventually, we receive a SYN-ACK and reply with an ACK, moving to an established connection. When we’re done sending data, we send a FIN, and receive an ACK. Eventually, we receive a FIN, and the connection is closed again.
blocks.zh_html: 在简化的状态图中，我们从关闭(closed)状态开始(没有连接在进行中)。要开始连接，我们发送一个 SYN。最终，我们收到一个 SYN-ACK 并回复一个 ACK，进入已建立(established)连接。当我们发完数据后，我们发送一个 FIN，并收到一个 ACK。最终，我们收到一个 FIN，连接再次关闭。

blocks.en: Piggybacking
blocks.zh_html: 捎带确认

blocks.en: Because TCP is full duplex, it’s possible for a packet to both acknowledge some data and send new data.
blocks.zh_html: 由于 TCP 是全双工的，一个分组有可能既确认一些数据，又发送新数据。

blocks.en: When the recipient gets a packet, if it has no data to send, the recipient has two choices. The recipient could either immediately send the ack, with no data to send. Or, the recipient could wait until it has some data to send, and then send the ack with the new data. This latter approach is called piggybacking.
blocks.zh_html: 当接收方收到一个分组时，如果没有数据要发送，接收方有两个选择。接收方可以立即发送 ack，不附带任何数据。或者，接收方可以等待直到有数据要发送，然后发送带新数据的 ack。后一种方法称为捎带确认(piggybacking)。

blocks.en: In practice, one reason we might not piggyback is because TCP is implemented in the operating system, separate from the application.
blocks.zh_html: 实践中，我们不使用捎带的一个原因是 TCP 在操作系统中实现，与应用是分离的。

blocks.en: Consider the operating system, which has no idea what the application code is doing. When the operating system receives a packet, it doesn’t know when the sender will have more data to send (or if the sender will ever have more data to send), so it might be stuck waiting a long time before it’s able to piggyback the ack with some new data.
blocks.zh_html: 考虑操作系统，它完全不知道应用代码在做什么。当操作系统收到一个分组时，它不知道发送方何时会有更多数据要发送(或者发送方是否会有更多数据要发送)，因此它可能会在能够将 ack 与新数据一起捎带之前等待很长时间。

blocks.en: On the other side, consider the application, which has no idea what the operating system is doing. The application is running on the bytestream abstraction, and isn’t thinking about packets at all, so it has no way to think about piggybacking at all.
blocks.zh_html: 另一方面，考虑应用程序，它完全不知道操作系统在做什么。应用运行在字节流抽象上，根本没有考虑分组的事情，因此它根本无法思考捎带确认的问题。

blocks.en: Piggybacking is further complicated by the fact that the operating system isn’t running every program simultaneously. Thinking back to a computer architecture course (like CS 61C at UC Berkeley), the CPU is constantly switching between different processes on your computer, depending on what needs attention. It would be pretty silly if, every time a TCP packet arrived, the CPU interrupted what it was doing to pass that packet to the application, and gave the application some time to respond. Instead, when a TCP packet arrives, the operating system might send out the ack, before the application gets a chance to piggyback new data on the ack.
blocks.zh_html: 捎带确认还因操作系统并非同时运行每个程序而变得更加复杂。回想一下计算机体系结构课程(如 UC Berkeley 的 CS 61C)，CPU 会根据需要不断地在你的计算机上的不同进程之间切换。如果每次 TCP 分组到达时，CPU 都中断当前工作，将该分组传递给应用，并给应用一些时间来响应，这将非常低效。相反，当 TCP 分组到达时，操作系统可能会先发出 ack，然后应用才有机会在 ack 上捎带新数据。

blocks.en: One case where data is always piggybacked is the SYN-ACK packet in the handshake. In addition to the ack, we’re piggybacking our own initial sequence number. This doesn’t have the problem discussed above, since the TCP handshake is entirely performed by the operating system. (The application isn’t thinking about SYN or SYN-ACK packets at all.)
blocks.zh_html: 一个数据总是被捎带的情况是握手过程中的 SYN-ACK 分组。除了 ack 之外，我们还捎带了自己的初始序列号。这没有上述问题，因为 TCP 握手完全由操作系统执行。(应用程序完全不考虑 SYN 或 SYN-ACK 分组。)

blocks.en: Sliding Window
blocks.zh_html: 滑动窗口

blocks.en: When we discussed packets, we defined the window as the number of packets that could be in flight at any given time. Now that we’re implementing TCP in terms of bytes, we’ll define the sliding window as the maximum number of contiguous bytes that can be in flight at any given time.
blocks.zh_html: 当我们讨论分组时，我们将窗口(window)定义为任意时刻可以在途(in flight)的分组数量。现在我们以字节为单位实现 TCP，我们将滑动窗口(sliding window)定义为任意时刻可以在途的连续字节的最大数量。

blocks.en: The restriction of the in-flight bytes being contiguous is different from before. Our packet-based window definition allowed for non-contiguous packets (e.g. 5, 7, 8) to be in-flight. However, the bytes in flight are required to be consecutive, with no gaps. This requirement creates a window (range of bytes) in the byte stream.
blocks.zh_html: 在途字节必须是连续的这一限制与之前不同。我们基于分组的窗口定义允许非连续的分组(例如 5、7、8)在途。然而，在途字节必须是连续的，不能有间隙。这个要求在字节流中创建了一个窗口(字节的范围)。

blocks.en: The left side of the window is the first unacknowledged byte (as determined by the ack number from the recipient). Starting at this byte, the next W bytes, up to the right side of the window, can be in-flight.
blocks.zh_html: 窗口的左边界是第一个未确认的字节(由接收方的确认号确定)。从这个字节开始，接下来的 W 个字节，直到窗口的右边界，可以在途。

blocks.en: Note that even if some of the intermediate bytes in this window were acknowledged, we still cannot send more bytes beyond the window. The only way we can send more bytes is if the window slides to the right, i.e. when the ack number increases (bytes on the left side of the window are acknowledged).
blocks.zh_html: 注意，即使此窗口中的某些中间字节已被确认，我们仍然不能发送窗口之外的更多字节。我们能够发送更多字节的唯一方式是窗口向右滑动，即当确认号增加时(窗口左侧的字节被确认)。

blocks.en: Recall that the window size (which determines the right edge of the window) is limited by flow control and congestion control. In the case of flow control, the window size is decided by the window advertised by the recipient. The recipient decides the advertised window based on the amount of buffer space available on the receiver end.
blocks.zh_html: 回忆一下，窗口大小(决定窗口的右边缘)受到流量控制(flow control)和拥塞控制(congestion control)的限制。在流量控制的情况下，窗口大小由接收方通告的窗口(advertised window)决定。接收方根据其接收端可用的缓冲区空间量来决定通告窗口。

blocks.en: Detecting Loss and Re-Sending Data
blocks.zh_html: 检测丢失和重传数据

blocks.en: There are two conditions for data to be re-sent. Only one condition (not both) needs to be true to trigger a re-send.
blocks.zh_html: 有两种条件会触发数据重传。只需要满足一个条件(不是两个)即可触发重传。

blocks.en: The first trigger for retransmission is a timer (data not acknowledged after some time). In packet-based TCP, every packet had a timer, and when the timer expired without that packet being acked, we would re-send that packet.
blocks.zh_html: 重传的第一个触发条件是一个定时器(数据在一段时间后未被确认)。在基于分组的 TCP 中，每个分组都有一个定时器，当定时器到期而该分组未被确认时，我们会重传该分组。

blocks.en: In byte-based TCP, instead of one timer per byte or per packet, we will only have a single timer, corresponding to the first unacknowledged byte (left side of the window). If the timer expires, we will re-send the left-most unacknowledged segment. Recall that the timer length is based on the RTT, and the RTT is estimated using measurements of the time between sending data and receiving an ack. Also, recall that the timer is reset every time a new ack arrives (and the window changes).
blocks.zh_html: 在基于字节的 TCP 中，我们不是为每个字节或每个分组使用一个定时器，而是只使用一个定时器，对应于第一个未确认的字节(窗口的左边界)。如果定时器到期，我们将重传最左边的未确认段。回忆一下，定时器长度基于 RTT，而 RTT 是通过测量发送数据和接收 ack 之间的时间来估计的。此外，每次新的 ack 到达时(以及窗口改变时)，定时器都会重置。

blocks.en: The second trigger for retransmission is assuming that data is lost when we receive acks for subsequent packets. In packet-based TCP with cumulative acks (which is what TCP uses), we would re-send a packet if we received K duplicate acks (K=3 is common), which indicated that three subsequent packets were acknowledged.
blocks.zh_html: 重传的第二个触发条件是当收到后续分组的 ack 时，假定数据已丢失。在基于分组且使用累积 ack(即 TCP 使用的)的 TCP 中，如果我们收到 K 个重复 ack(K=3 是常见值)，表示有三个后续分组已被确认，我们将重传一个分组。

blocks.en: In byte-based TCP, if we receive K duplicate acks, we will re-send the left-most unacknowledged segment.
blocks.zh_html: 在基于字节的 TCP 中，如果我们收到 K 个重复 ack，我们将重传最左边的未确认段。

blocks.en: TCP Header
blocks.zh_html: TCP 首部

blocks.en: The TCP header has 16-bit source and destination ports.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 首部有 16 位的源端口(source port)和目的端口(destination port)。

blocks.en: The TCP header has a 32-bit sequence number (byte offset of the first byte in this packet), and a 32-bit acknowledgement number (highest contiguous sequence number received, plus one).
blocks.zh_html: TCP 首部有一个 32 位的序列号(sequence number，本分组中第一个字节的字节偏移量)和一个 32 位的确认号(acknowledgement number，已收到的最高连续序列号加一)。

blocks.en: The TCP header has a checksum over the entire data (not just the header), to detect corrupt data.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 首部有一个覆盖整个数据(不仅仅是首部)的校验和(checksum)，用于检测数据损坏。

blocks.en: The TCP header has the advertised window, which is used to support flow control and congestion control.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 首部有通告窗口(advertised window)，用于支持流量控制(flow control)和拥塞控制(congestion control)。

blocks.en: The header length specifies the number of 4-byte words in the TCP header. Assuming there are no additional options, this length is 5.
blocks.zh_html: 首部长度(header length)指定 TCP 首部中 4 字节字的数量。假设没有额外选项，这个长度是 5。

blocks.en: The flags are a sequence of bits that can be set to 1 or 0. When a bit is set to 1, the corresponding flag is enabled. Everybody understands the semantics of the header, so they know which bits correspond to which flags. There are four relevant flags for these notes.
blocks.zh_html: 标志位(flags)是一系列可以设置为 1 或 0 的比特位。当一个比特设置为 1 时，相应的标志被启用。每个人都知道首部的语义，因此他们知道哪些比特对应于哪些标志。对这些笔记来说，有四个相关的标志。

blocks.en: The SYN (synchronize) flag is turned on when the host is sending its ISN. This flag is usually only enabled in the first two messages of the three-way handshake.
blocks.zh_html: SYN(synchronize)标志在主机发送其 ISN 时开启。这个标志通常只在三次握手的前两条消息中启用。

blocks.en: The ACK (acknowledge) flag is turned on when the acknowledgment number is relevant and being used to ack data. If I want to send data, but didn’t receive any data that needs to be acked, I can turn this flag off, which tells the other host to ignore the ack number.
blocks.zh_html: ACK(acknowledge)标志在确认号相关且用于确认数据时开启。如果我想发送数据，但没有收到需要确认的数据，我可以关闭这个标志，告诉另一方忽略确认号。

blocks.en: There are 6 reserved bits after the header length that are always set to 0. You can safely ignore these.
blocks.zh_html: 首部长度后有 6 个保留位，始终设置为 0。你可以安全地忽略它们。

blocks.en: The urgent pointer can be used to mark certain bytes as urgent, which tells the recipient to send this data to the application as soon as possible. This is a historical field that we won’t cover any further.
blocks.zh_html: 紧急指针(urgent pointer)可用于将某些字节标记为紧急，告诉接收方尽快将这些数据发送给应用程序。这是一个历史字段，我们不再进一步讨论。

blocks.en: The TCP header can have additional options appended to the end (which would make the header longer), but we’ll ignore options for this class. For example, if you wanted to implement full-information acks, there is an option called selective acknowledgements (SACK) that can be added to the header.
blocks.zh_html: TCP 首部可以在末尾附加额外的选项(这会使首部更长)，但我们在本课程中忽略这些选项。例如，如果你想实现全信息 ack，有一个称为选择性确认(selective acknowledgements, SACK)的选项可以添加到首部。
